name: the dead arrive
did: Coastline is playable again. You no longer fall through the water into an endless void -- the lake bed was a 520-metre-wide box that did not collide, and past it there was no bed at all. The dead now actually reach you from every way in: they were walking straight at you with no pathfinding, and then jamming on the lake bed one centimetre at a time. Falling off a height or out of the world kills you. Dropped guns rest on the floor instead of falling through it, and clear after ten minutes.
onAccept: Your round is saved and the map is rebuilt. You keep your points, your guns and your perks, and the dead hold off for three minutes while you get set.
